task_completion.description: The agent successfully navigated to the 'Customer RMA' window in iDempiere.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The window title or tab shows 'Customer RMA' or 'Return Material Authorization'.

task_completion.description: The Business Partner field is set to 'C&W Construction'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Business Partner' field contains the text 'C&W Construction'.

task_completion.description: The Name/Description field is set to 'Defective Patio Set Return'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Name' or 'Description' field contains the exact string 'Defective Patio Set Return'.

task_completion.description: The RMA is linked to an existing shipment for the customer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Shipment/Receipt' field (or 'Inout') is populated with a shipment record associated with C&W Construction.

task_completion.description: At least one RMA line is created with a quantity of 1.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'RMA Line' tab or sub-grid shows a record with 'Quantity' set to '1' and a product selected.

task_completion.description: The document status remains in 'Drafted' or 'In Progress' and is not completed/closed.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'DocStatus' or 'Document Status' field shows 'Drafted' (DR) or 'In Progress' (IP).

integrity.description: The agent used the iDempiere web interface rather than executing direct database queries or terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the iDempiere UI elements and form fields.

integrity.description: The agent selected a real shipment from the search/lookup dialog rather than typing a random ID.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the lookup/search window for shipments being used to select a record.

integrity.description: The agent navigated the menu system or used the search bar to find the RMA window.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sequence of screenshots shows the navigation process through the iDempiere menu or application tree.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The business partner must be 'C&W Construction'. The description must be 'Defective Patio Set Return'. The RMA must be linked to a valid shipment. The RMA line quantity must be exactly 1. The document status must be 'Drafted' (often represented as 'DR' in the status field).
